episodeTitle.en: Developing a growth model + marketplace growth strategy | Dan Hockenmaier
episodeTitle.zh: 构建增长模型与市场增长策略 | 丹·霍肯迈尔

guestBioOfficial.en: Dan Hockenmaier is an expert on marketplace strategy and growth. He was previously the Director of Growth at Thumbtack as well as a partner at Reforge, where he co-created the monetization track. Currently, he is the Head of Strategy and Analytics at Faire. In today’s episode, Dan shares the building blocks of a growth model, important considerations when building your growth model, and how to get started. We also chat about retention best practices, the complexity of building a marketplace, the future of marketplaces, and when it makes sense to add a SaaS business to a marketplace, and vice versa.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 丹·霍肯迈尔是市场策略与增长领域的专家。他曾担任Thumbtack增长总监，也是Reforge合伙人，共同开创了变现路径。目前，他担任Faire的战略与分析负责人。本期节目中，丹将分享增长模型的构建要素、构建增长模型时需考虑的关键因素，以及如何破题。我们还将探讨留存最佳实践、构建市场的复杂性、市场未来的发展方向，以及何时将SaaS业务引入市场，反之亦然。

title.en: Developing a growth model + marketplace growth strategy | Dan Hockenmaier
title.zh: 构建增长模型与市场增长策略 | 丹·霍肯迈尔

summary.en: A growth model breaks a business down into a few building blocks — acquisition, retention, and monetization for SaaS, plus transaction volume and order value for marketplaces — and the biggest, most under-appreciated lever is almost always retention, especially the very first user experience. Building the model yourself from first principles is the point (templates help little), and the payoff is a common currency to allocate resources across teams during planning. For marketplaces, demand is the only thing that truly matters: liquidity is the first metric to nail, share of wallet measures depth over breadth, and you should acquire supply only insofar as it improves the customer experience. The future of marketplaces trends toward higher commissions for more value-chain work, with businesses that need supplier creativity (Etsy, Faire) staying marketplaces while commoditized ones (ride-sharing) consolidate into owned-supply models.
summary.zh: 增长模型把一个生意拆成几个积木块——SaaS 是获客、留存、变现，市场类再加上交易量和客单价——而最大、最被低估的杠杆几乎永远是留存，尤其是第一次用户体验。从第一性原理自己把模型搭出来才是关键（模板帮助不大），回报是能在规划时给跨团队资源分配提供一把通用货币。对市场来说，需求才是唯一真正要紧的：流动性是第一个要搞定的指标，钱包份额衡量的是深度而非广度，而且你只在『它能改善客户体验』的范围内去获取供给。市场的未来趋势是：为价值链里更多的工作收更高佣金；需要供给方创意的生意（Etsy、Faire）会留在市场模式，而商品化的（打车）会整合进自有供给模型。
